const result=await tools.image_gen__imagegen({transparent_background:true,prompt:"Create one production sprite COMPONENT ATLAS for a cozy Chinese handpainted 2D farming game: warm golden-brown farm HEN and small fluffy yellow CHICK. Transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard baked in, no text, no scene, no ground shadows. Portrait atlas EXACTLY 6 columns and 8 rows of equal cells, 1536x2048 image. Each cell centered, distinct separated cutout with clear padding. Rows 1-4 adult hen facing front, left, right, back; rows 5-8 yellow chick facing front,left,right,back. Columns in EVERY row: 1 rounded feathered torso ONLY without head legs wings tail, with painted volume; 2 head and short neck ONLY, eyes/beak/comb included adult, chick no comb; 3 one wing ONLY; 4 one full leg with foot ONLY; 5 feather tail ONLY; 6 second head same direction with eyes CLOSED for blinking. Pieces fit anatomically together in a neutral standing bird. Each column piece centered in its own cell at consistent scale for that age. Adult body width ~170px height150, adult head ~95px, leg100, wing110, tail90. Chick torso120px round, head105px round, leg50px, small wing60px and tiny tail45px; genuinely juvenile large head/short legs, not scaled adult. Four explicit directions, front/back symmetrical body views and both side views. Soft gouache and fine pencil edges, earthy ochre feathers, subtle contour shadow and top-left warm highlight, realistic soft volume with charming believable anatomy, grounded pastoral illustrated game style. Fully opaque inside every cutout, truly transparent outside; no frames, grids, lettering or extra objects. Preserve each component separated, do not assemble full animals."});store("ranch_hen_generated",result);for(const c of (result.content||[])){if(c.type==="text")text(c.text.slice(0,1500));}if(!result.content)text(result);
